title: Open-source AcDs and modeler-route audit
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source research and plan update
scope: Reconcile released ACadSharp Prototype_1b parsing with its pull-request review and corpus-comparison discussion
Compare LibreDWG AcDs source and release caveats without generalizing from one revision
Bound ACadRust and CADCraft ACIS/AcDs claims by actual test design and shared implementation lineage
Refresh stock FreeCAD importer boundaries and refine implementation-ready local gates

sources.observation: The merged PR adds a structured DWG Prototype_1b/DataStorage reader. Its discussion separates raw section parsing from entity-payload attachment, reports an early alignment-anchor problem and a stale secondary segment-index/oversized-count failure shape, and later reports a 423-DWG referenced-entry comparison with 3,715 matching hashes after the anchor correction. These are peer-authored reports, not independently reproduced in this repository.

sources.project: ACadSharp ACIS payload read PR #1139 and v3.6.51 release
sources.observation: The PR describes DXF group 1/3 SAT reconstruction, DXF R2013+ ACDSDATA records with group-320 owner and group-310 chunk mapping, and DWG modeler/AcDs payload reading. This is structural payload extraction/association scope, not B-rep or kernel semantics.

Current source includes an AcDs section-reading path, while project NEWS still describes DataStorage handling as incomplete and some newer SAB extraction as brute-force. Open issue #1411 reports missing payloads for the named 0.14.8593 build. These facts support revision-specific comparison, not a blanket support or no-support conclusion.

The project advertises DXF/DWG and SAT/SAB plus B-rep APIs. Its public tests include same-library roundtrips and generated bodies; the AcDs test helper fabricates marker-shaped SAB bytes for opaque transport. Current issues include malformed-input panic and large-allocation reports. None of this independently verifies general ACIS semantics or external CAD acceptance.

v0.7 release notes advertise keeping incoming ACIS data on save through ACDSDATA. The current gap ledger says newly modeled REGIONs are saved as closed polylines without ACIS, and the project identifies ACadRust as its DWG backend. Issue #604 reports an AutoCAD audit with six errors on one CADCraft-produced file; it is not independently reproduced here. Opaque retention must not be conflated with native solid authoring or independent codec/semantic evidence.

sources.project: FreeCAD current Draft DXF/DWG import documentation and source
sources.observation: The DXF guide states that embedded binary ACIS/SAT solids cannot currently be read by stock FreeCAD; the C++ and legacy importer entity lists differ. The DWG route is an external converter followed by the selected DXF importer, so converter success, explicit-entity import, and ACIS-solid consumption are distinct outcomes.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S2: keep modern DWG Prototype_1b section parsing, indexed-record disposition, exact per-handle payload join, and ACIS semantics as separate stages
PAR-07/S7/S8: keep DXF legacy group 1/3, DXF ACDSDATA/SAB, DWG inline payloads, and DWG AcDs DataStorage as distinct versioned routes
PAR-07/S8: account for every modeler source entity, including block/INSERT occurrences, as retained/transformed/refused; silent writer omission is failure
S2/S8: keep native FreeCAD explicit-entity acceptance separate from embedded ACIS semantic consumption
assessment.planImpact: Use released ACadSharp only as a pinned structural/payload comparator; retain separate DWG and DXF carrier routes, exact owner/key/hash closure, page/chunk/index negatives, writer disposition, semantic metrics, and named consumer acceptance. ACadRust/CADCraft self-roundtrips and stock FreeCAD import success do not promote ACIS or broad DWG support.

method.limitations: Peer reports, test designs, and project capability statements were reviewed but not reproduced. ACadSharp's reported corpus comparisons are contributor-authored; the stale-segment failure disposition in the released version was not independently established. ACadRust and CADCraft were not run. FreeCAD documentation constrains stock importer scope but does not prove every version/backend behavior. No new reference drawing or geometric truth was obtained.
